author: ValWood
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**

InterPro:IPR006735

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

[Q10154](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprot/Q10154)
rtf2 https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC1D4.09c


* **Description of issue**

Comprehensive analysis shows that fission yeast rtf2's role in replication for processing is an indirect phenotype.
(This is likely to be true for other species). The  replication processing, if correct is likely restricted to metazoa (could not be ruled out because 
these is some supporting evidence).

However, there is good support that splicing is   the ancestral role

https://www.pombase.org/reference/PMID:37615341
title: InterPro:IPR006735 not GO:1902979    mitotic DNA replication termination (is a splicing factor)
